newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Six killed in south Albania land battle.
newsitem.headline: Six killed in south Albania land battle.

text.p: Five men and a woman were killed and 14 people injured in a battle over land in the village of Kapinove in southern Albania, the Albanian news agency ATA said on Tuesday.
The agency quoted district police headquarters as saying the clash happened on Monday when three related men went to the village to try to resolve a land dispute with another family.
Women were also among the injured, who were all from the village, the agency said.
